Facts: A group of people (宋某, 张1某军, 小某, 李某某, 董某某) went to a night club, had a dispute with victim 杨某某. Later, victim came with a battle knife, they fought. Several defendants used weapons: 董某某 used a bench to hit head/back, 宋某 used a short knife to stab back, 李某某 used a pointed knife to stab waist. Victim died from kidney artery rupture due to sharp weapon.

Thus, the crime is homicide (intentional killing) using a knife, i.e., murder (故意杀人). Possibly also "故意伤害致死" but the facts show they intentionally attacked with knives, causing death. The appropriate charge under Chinese criminal law: "故意杀人罪". Also possibly "聚众斗殴致人死亡罪"? But they used weapons, premeditated? They had a dispute, then victim came with a knife, they fought. The defendants used knives to stab. Could be "故意杀人罪" (intentional homicide). Also "非法持有刀具"? Not relevant.
